debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (recommended for initial setup or troubleshooting).

log_file.description: Path to the main log file. Must be writable by the autorenamer service.

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (in megabytes) of the log file before rotation.

max_log_backups.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

work_dir.description: Directory used for temporary files during renaming (e.g., during atomic moves).

source_dir.description: Root directory to scan recursively for files to rename.

dest_dir.description: Target directory for renamed files. Leave empty to rename files in-place.

create_dest_dir.description: Create destination directory if it does not exist.

filename_pattern.description: Regex pattern to extract structured data from existing filenames.

output_pattern.description: Jinja-style format for generating new filenames from extracted fields.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads to process files concurrently.

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum file size (in MB) to process. Set to 0 to disable size limit.

file_extensions.description: List of file extensions to consider for renaming. Only files with these extensions will be processed.

regex.description: A regex pattern to match full file paths that should be skipped.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the exclusion rule.

exclude_patterns.description: List of regex patterns for files/directories to skip during scanning.

description.description: Brief description of the rule's purpose.

condition.description: Jinja2 expression (evaluated as boolean) to decide whether rule applies (e.g., `{season} is none or {season} == 0`).

then.description: Output pattern to use if condition is true (e.g., `{title} - Special.{ext}`).

else.description: Output pattern to use if condition is false (e.g., `{title} - {season}x{episode}.{ext}`).

rename_rules.description: Conditional renaming rules evaluated in order. Use to handle special cases (e.g., specials, multi-episode files).

mtime_handling.description: How to handle file modification times. Options: 'preserve' (keep original), 'use_file_date' (set from parsed metadata), 'use_current' (set to current time).

dry_run.description: Preview actions without actually renaming files. Logs would show what would change.
